## Source Code

::: panel-tabset

#### Python
```python
a=1 + 1
for i in range(1,10):
# The code block within the loop will execute once for each iteration 
# This line prints the result of i raised to the power of 2 using the ** operator
  print(i ** 2)
```

#### R
```R
a=1 + 1
for (i in 1:10) { 
# The code block within the loop will execute once for each iteration 
# This line prints the result of i raised to the power of 2 using the ** operator
  print(i ** 2)
}
```
:::

## Equations

inline math: $E = mc^{2}$

display math:
$$E = mc^{2}$$
Some advanced equations:

$$\begin{aligned}
\div{\vb{v}} &=0 \\
\rho\pdv{\vb{v}}{t}+\rho\vb{v}\cdot\grad{\vb{v}}&=-\grad{p}+\eta\laplacian{\vb{v}}+\rho\vb{f}
\end{aligned}$$ {#eq-NS}

@eq-NS is the _Navier-Stokes equations of viscous incompressible fluids with uniform density_.

## Line

The equation of any straight line, called a linear equation, can be written as:

$$
y = mx + b
$$
:::

See @thm-line.

::: {.proof}
